what.text: This page follows refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo living in the Republic of the Congo, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 29152 of these refugees there, 2.5% of all refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
Uganda hosts the most refugees from the country, followed by Burundi, Zambia and Rwanda.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of DR Congo in periods from 1996, at war level in many years, and in every year from 2016 to 2025.
From 2016 to 2025 the opponents it records include Kamuina Nsapu, RNL, CNPSC and M23, and it also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2017 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1986 at 520 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 131648, at the end of 2011, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2000 to 2003 and 2009 to 2012.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the Republic of the Congo.
These are year-end totals for the Republic of the Congo only, reported to UNHCR.
